title: Fluvv Classifications
description: A repository's own vocabulary for columns' ODCS `classification`, replacing the default one. One file, anywhere under governance/. See docs/fluvv/SPEC.md Section 5.4.

name.description: The value columns use as their `classification`.

catalogTag.description: The tag a column with this value gets in a catalog, e.g. PII.Sensitive. Must exist there. Without one, the column gets no tag.
